description: Family wire-parameter acceptance wall (ADR-0038). One shared fixture table, loaded by every product repo's wire-params contract test: Python factories via the vendored app/ai/wire_params.py, desktop via resolveMaxTokensParam/wireTokenParamFetch. Rows are language-neutral; a change here is a contract change (one dev commit + one sync run).

maxTokensParam.name: openai type rides the modern wire
openai type with empty base counts as the OpenAI default
openai type pointed at a proxy falls back to the compatible wire
compatible row pointing at OpenAI gets the modern wire
compatible row elsewhere keeps the classic wire
override max_tokens wins on the OpenAI endpoint
override max_completion_tokens wins on a compatible endpoint
override none strips the cap everywhere

temperatureOmission.name: explicit default-1 value rides the wire

temperatureNote: Rows run against a model id whose family accepts temperature (temperatureModelId) so the rows pin the omit-unless-configured rule, not family locking. Family locking on reasoning ids is repo-local behavior (desktop's bare-id guard), not part of this wall.

chatTransport.name: auto rides the Responses wire on the OpenAI endpoint
auto rides responses with an empty base on an openai-typed row
auto stays on completions for a compatible row
responses honored on the OpenAI endpoint
responses honored for a compatible row pointing at OpenAI
responses ignored off the OpenAI endpoint (local server)
responses ignored on an OpenAI-typed proxy
explicit completions pins the legacy wire even on OpenAI

chatTransportNote: The knob is model-scoped config (chat_transport column / chatTransport field). 'responses' is honored only when the base URL rides OpenAI's own API — compatible servers don't implement /responses. The responses path must be constructed store-less (store=False / zdrEnabled) everywhere.
